newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall further on Bulgaria discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall further on Bulgaria discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell further on Wednesday at Bulgaria's Finance Ministry auctions of one-week and four-week discount T-bill issues, central bank figures showed.

The average yields to maturity of the two issues were 3.04 percent and 15.49 percent, respectively, down from 3.23 percent and 15.93 percent on Tuesday and from 3.44 and 16.24 percent at Monday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 121.523 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 101.603 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
The ministry has issued one-week and four-week discount T-bills daily since January 20 to regulate banks' liquidity.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 68,455.5 million levs 53,067 million levs
Bids approved 63,365.5 million levs 38,237 million levs
